title: Unit Economics Dashboard (Internal) — Success Metrics (Adoption + Impact) [working]
content:
Context
- Project: Internal “Unit Economics” dashboard in Console. Primary metric: blended $/1M output tokens with drilldowns by model(+version/quant profile), region, customer tier.
- Audience: Finance (methodology + exec reporting), Product (prioritization), Eng/SRE (regression detection + diagnostics).
- v1 is internal-only; goal is to make cost drivers visible and actionable + reduce time-to-diagnosis for cost regressions.

This doc: how we’ll know v1 “worked” (adoption + impact) + what we must instrument to measure it.

Principles
1) We need both adoption and impact; adoption alone is vanity.
2) Metrics must be attributable to the dashboard (vs. general cost work) as much as possible.
3) Finance trustworthiness is a prerequisite/guardrail (recon + coverage). If trust fails, adoption/impact metrics become meaningless.
4) Prefer simple, auditable measurement that we can automate by end of v1.1.

North Star
NS1: Cost regression detection + diagnosis becomes faster and more reliable.
- Candidate North Star metric: Median time-to-diagnosis (TTD) for unit-cost regressions (from first anomaly detection to identified primary driver and owner).
- Why: aligns Product/Eng/Finance, ties to “actionable,” and is measurable if we standardize workflows.

Definitions (working)
- “Viewer”: user loads the Unit Economics dashboard page and triggers at least 1 successful query (non-empty, non-error). (Exclude 401/403, exclude internal dev env.)
- “Active viewer (weekly)”: unique viewer with >= 2 meaningful interactions in a 7-day window.
  - Meaningful interaction: change filter (model/region/tier/time), click into drilldown table row, open a detail drawer, or export/copy query.
  - Note: want to avoid counting someone who just lands on the page via link.
- “Unit-cost regression”: increase in blended $/1M output tokens of >= +8% vs trailing 7d baseline, sustained for >= 6 consecutive hours, with data confidence >= 0.9.
  - Thresholds are placeholders. We should tune after 2–3 weeks of production data to reduce false positives.
- “Diagnosis”: documented statement of primary driver(s) + proposed fix or follow-up (e.g., “cache hit rate dropped in us-east for model X due to rollout Y; owner Z; mitigation A”).

Adoption metrics (leading indicators)
A1. Weekly Active Viewers (WAV)
- Target (first 4 weeks post-rollout):
  - Finance: 5–8 WAV (CFO/FP&A + 1–2 analysts)
  - Product: 6–10 WAV (Console/Optimize + 1–2 PMM/leadership)
  - Eng/SRE/Analytics: 10–20 WAV (telemetry, runtime, platform, oncall)
- Measurement: Console analytics event `unit_econ.page_view` + `unit_econ.interaction` with user_id + org/team inferred via Okta group.
- Notes:
  - Don’t over-optimize the totals; focus on sustained usage by the 3 primary personas.
  - We should provide a “Finance view” saved preset to drive consistent usage.

A2. Retention of core users
- Metric: % of users who are active in week N and also active in week N+2.
- Target: >= 50% for Finance cohort, >= 35% for Eng cohort by week 6.
- Rationale: this is an internal tool; we want repeat use tied to operating cadence.

A3. Depth of investigation (proxy)
- Metric: average number of drilldown actions per active session.
- Target: >= 3 drilldown actions/session for Eng persona; >= 2 for Finance.
- Caveat: too high could mean UX confusion. Pair with a quick pulse survey.

A4. Saved views / shared links usage
- Metric: number of saved views created + number of share-links opened.
- Target: >= 10 saved views created within first month; >= 25 share-link opens.
- Why: indicates the dashboard is being used in weekly reporting + cross-team triage.

A5. Internal “self-serve” reduction (qualitative)
- Metric: count of ad-hoc asks in Slack like “can someone pull $/token by model/region” that get answered with a dashboard link.
- Measurement approach (lightweight):
  - Track in #eng-platform and #finance: add emoji reaction “📊” (or a standardized tag) when a request is answered by dashboard.
  - TODO: choose non-annoying convention; may not scale.

Impact metrics (outcomes)
I1. Time-to-diagnosis (TTD) for unit-cost regressions (North Star)
- Metric: median (and p90) hours from first detection to diagnosis recorded.
- Baseline (pre-dashboard): estimate via incident threads + manual SQL time; anecdotal 1–3 days.
- Target (post-dashboard, by week 8):
  - Median TTD < 6 hours
  - p90 TTD < 24 hours
- Instrumentation needed:
  - Standard “regression ticket” template in Linear (or Jira) with timestamps.
  - When a regression is confirmed, open Linear issue with label `unit-econ-regression`.
  - Add fields (or checklist): `detected_at`, `diagnosed_at`, `driver_category`, `root_cause_link`.
- Owner: Talia to align with program process; Allison/Sean to align with oncall flow.

I2. Regression detection rate (coverage)
- Metric: % of regressions (per definition) that are detected and triaged within 12 hours.
- Detection sources:
  - (a) SRE alerts from pipeline + anomaly checks (ENG-8429)
  - (b) Human discovery via Finance weekly review
- Target: >= 80% within 12 hours by week 10.
- Notes:
  - This metric is partly alerting quality, partly dashboard usability. Still good as a joint KPI.

I3. “Driver identified” rate
- Metric: % of regression investigations where we can assign a primary driver category within 24 hours.
- Driver categories (initial):
  - Cache hit rate change
  - Batching efficiency/utilization
  - Output length shift
  - Prefill/decode ratio shift (long context)
  - Quantization profile change
  - Region cost-rate-card change
  - Capacity/idle allocation shift
  - Data quality / metering bug
  - Other/unknown
- Target: >= 70% by week 10.
- Why: pushes us toward the dashboard’s promise (actionable diagnosis), and highlights missing signals.

I4. Cost optimization prioritization throughput
- Metric: number of cost-optimization work items whose justification references dashboard evidence (link to a breakdown view + time range + dimension slice).
- Target: 8+ per quarter after steady state (not necessarily in the first month).
- Measurement: search Linear for links containing `/unit-economics` route or saved-view IDs.

I5. Exec / Finance reporting cycle time
- Metric: time for FP&A to produce QTD unit-cost view for exec pack once the month closes.
- Baseline: manual spreadsheets + SQL pulls.
- Target: reduce by 50% (e.g., from ~1 day to < 4 hours) by the first quarter end after launch.
- Note: depends on reconciliation + rate-card versioning stability.

Trust + quality guardrails (must-hit, not “success metrics”)
G1. Reconciliation vs billing / infra spend
- Metric: absolute % delta between dashboard totals and billing totals at month-to-date + quarter-to-date.
- Thresholds (draft):
  - Hosted/self-serve: <= 2% delta MTD
  - Dedicated: <= 3% delta MTD (more tagging edge cases)
  - Private: tracked but may be higher initially depending on cost attribution inputs
- This is a launch gate for Finance sign-off.

G2. Data completeness / freshness SLO
- Metric: hourly completeness % (hours with full dimension coverage) and freshness lag.
- Target (align with SLO doc):
  - >= 99% of hours available within 2 hours (rolling 7d)
  - Missing-dimension rows <= 0.5% (region/tier/model/quant_profile coverage)
- If we can’t meet this, we need a visible confidence indicator on the UI and alerts must fire.

G3. Privacy / sensitivity
- Metric: no customer-identifiable exposure through drilldowns/top-N tables.
- Enforcement: aggregation thresholds + redaction rules; audited in security review.

Instrumentation plan (what to log)
Console analytics events (internal)
- `unit_econ.page_view`
  - props: user_id, okta_groups (or derived persona), entrypoint (nav/link), environment, feature_flag_state
- `unit_econ.query_success`
  - props: query_type (timeseries/breakdown/topN), group_by (model/region/tier/quant_profile), filters_present, time_range_bucket (24h/7d/30d/custom), result_row_count_bucket (0/1-10/10-100/100+), latency_ms_bucket
- `unit_econ.interaction`
  - props: interaction_type (filter_change/drilldown_click/sort/export/share/open_saved_view), dimension_touched
- `unit_econ.query_error`
  - props: error_class (authz/timeout/backend_error/no_data), http_status

Workflow instrumentation
- Linear label: `unit-econ-regression`
- Required fields/checklist (template): detected_at, suspected_slice, dashboard_link, diagnosed_at, driver_category, owner_team, followup_ticket

Rollout milestones (for measurement windows)
- Phase 0: Dogfood (Eng + Product) — start date: TBD (target early Feb)
- Phase 1: Add Finance cohort — target mid Feb after reconciliation report is stable
- Phase 2: Broader internal — target after SLOs/alerts + confidence indicator are in place

Targets by phase (draft)
Phase 0 (Dogfood, 2 weeks)
- WAV: 10–15
- Collect top 10 UX paper cuts + top 5 missing drilldowns
- Establish baseline TTD from at least 2 investigations

Phase 1 (Finance added, 2–4 weeks)
- Finance WAV: 5+
- Reconciliation delta within threshold for hosted + dedicated MTD
- First FP&A QTD pull done using dashboard (shadow mode OK)

Phase 2 (Steady state, 6–10 weeks)
- Median TTD < 6 hours (for regressions meeting definition)
- Detection rate >= 80% within 12 hours
- Driver identified rate >= 70% within 24 hours

Open questions / TODOs
- Confirm regression thresholds with SRE + Finance (8%? 6 hours? baseline window?).
- Agree on “confidence >= 0.9” definition (coverage-based? reconciliation-based? both?).
- Decide persona mapping source (Okta groups vs team mapping table). Avoid creating a separate source of truth.
- Define how we handle rate-card updates in metrics (e.g., do they create “regressions” that are expected?). Might need to tag rate-card-change events so regressions can be excluded or annotated.
- Determine whether we measure “time-to-mitigation” as separate from TTD.
- Add a lightweight quarterly pulse survey for internal users: “trust,” “time saved,” “actionability” (3 questions).

Notes from recent conversations (rough)
- Finance cares about consistency + reconciliation more than fancy drilldowns in v1.
- Eng wants quick triage slices: model x region x tier + cache/batching signals on the same screen.
- Product wants this to feed Optimize: identify which lever (cache/batch/quant) is worth investing in.

Owner / next steps
- Aditya: finalize metric list + targets with Marissa + Talia; propose to include in exec readout.
- Logan/Nadia: confirm which telemetry fields are guaranteed for v1 and when.
- Chloe/Felix: confirm Console analytics hooks + saved-view IDs can be logged.
- Rishi/Laura: sign off on reconciliation thresholds and reporting cadence.
